name: Bauhaus Primer
summary: Circle, square, triangle and a black bar: a Bauhaus primer where the one shape that falls out of the grid is the anomaly.
look: Warm cream paper, flat geometric primitives in teal, amber and ink, heavy black rules and all-lowercase Manrope 800. Coral is used only for the element that breaks the grid.

components.name: Primer shapes
components.role: circle / square / triangle as metric tokens (teal, ink, amber)

components.name: Black bar
components.role: structural rule that wipes headlines and cuts diagonals

components.name: Lowercase universal type
components.role: Manrope 800 lowercase, Bayer-style, one serif italic accent word

components.name: Empty slot
components.role: dashed coral outline where a metric went missing

components.name: Fallen square
components.role: the anomaly — tilted coral block carrying the number

components.name: Block button
components.role: flat ink rectangle with a coral dot or amber triangle glyph

motion.name: Stamp-in
motion.how: shapes scale 0→1.06→1, back.out(2) 0.25 s, one per 8th note (0.25 s at 120 BPM)

motion.name: Gravity slip
motion.how: anomaly square rotates 0→−9° and drops 40 px, power3.in 0.4 s, landing on a downbeat

motion.name: Bar wipe
motion.how: black bar scaleX 0→1 from the left, expo.out 0.5 s, always on beat 1 of a bar; text rides behind it with clip-path

story: Hook: a 6×3 primer grid of shapes (38 dashboards) with one square slipping away on Friday. Reveal: bar, circle, triangle and square assemble around the Acme mark. Proof: three healthy shapes tick while the checkout square falls coral with −18%, since 09:42 after deploy #2231, and a human clicks the ink "roll back" block. CTA: "you ship. pulse watches." with a start free block.
adapt: Map your own metrics or features to the three primitives (e.g. circle = users, square = revenue, triangle = performance) and let the thing your product catches be the one that breaks the grid. Swap the button labels for your product's real action.

references.note: school overview: geometric simplicity, Kandinsky colour teaching
Bayer's all-lowercase sans for Bauhaus print

fit.risk: Can feel academic or like a kids' shape-sorter if the numbers are not big and the pacing is not tight.
